name_ja: UPRUN綱島鶴見川ハーフマラソン
full_name_ja: 第1回UPRUN綱島鶴見川ハーフマラソン
full_name_en: The 1st UPRUN Tsunashima Tsurumigawa Half Marathon
description_ja: 鶴見川河川敷を走るフラットで走りやすいコースで、初心者から上級者まで楽しめる大会です。自己ベスト更新やランニング練習にも適しており、自動計測でタイムも測定できます。ハーフ、10km、5km、親子5kmの種目があります。
description_en: This race is held on a flat, easy-to-run course along the Tsurumi River embankment and suits runners from beginners to advanced. It works well for chasing a personal best or for training, and times are recorded by automatic timing. Events include the half marathon, 10km, 5km and a parent-child 5km.
reception_note_ja: 受付は8時30分から各種目スタート30分前まで、受付会場は鶴見川樽町公園。ゼッケンや注意事項のパンフは当日受付で渡され、事前郵送はありません。開催2日前までにメールで詳細が通知されます。大会説明は各種目スタート20分前です。
reception_note_en: Reception opens at 8:30 and closes 30 minutes before each event start, at Tsurumigawa Tarumachi Park. Bibs and the information leaflet are handed out at race-day reception and are not mailed in advance. Details are sent by email up to 2 days before the event. The race briefing is held 20 minutes before each start.

course_info.highlights_ja: 鶴見川河川敷を走るフラットで走りやすいコース。綱島の鶴見川に設けた1周5kmの特設コースで、給水は1箇所。
course_info.highlights_en: A flat, easy-to-run course along the Tsurumi River embankment. It is a 5km-per-lap special course set up on the Tsurumi River in Tsunashima, with one water station.

categories.description_en: Open to men and women, junior high school age and above.

categories.description_ja: 男女中学生以上。ペア割は1組6,500円
categories.description_en: Open to men and women, junior high school age and above. Pair discount: 6,500 yen per pair.

categories.description_ja: 誰でも参加可。ペア割は1組5,500円
categories.description_en: Open to everyone. Pair discount: 5,500 yen per pair.

categories.description_ja: 3歳〜小学生のお子様と保護者。保護者1名とお子様1名の1組料金
categories.description_en: For children aged 3 to elementary school and their parent or guardian. Fee is per pair of one guardian and one child.
